deductions: Clarity −2: “Proposed 30-second opener” leaves reps unsure whether this wording is ready to use or awaiting approval.
Continuity −2: “Products and demonstrations” ends with unresolved preparation rather than a handoff or reference for obtaining approved demonstration guidance.

Clarity −7: “Eerin and Peter to confirm” assigns the product list, but “To be provided” does not clearly assign the screen demonstrations, presenters and approved claims or state a pre-distribution gate.

Actionability −8: “Products and demonstrations” gives no interim instruction for reps when demonstration guidance remains unavailable; the specialist rule covers questions but does not resolve whether or how to demonstrate.
Continuity −8: “Handoff and follow-up” requires assignment in Zoho CRM, but the following placeholder leaves the receiving coordinator and assignment process unresolved.
Clarity −8: “To be provided: follow-up coordinator, triage and assignment deadline, and escalation contact” has no owner for resolving these items or explicit pre-distribution gate.

Actionability −10: “Each follow-up…needs enough context” does not say who receives ordinary commitments or confirms assignment; the stand-lead and debrief instructions address urgent or incomplete records without supplying a complete interim handoff.
Clarity −6: “To be provided: the programmed qualifying questions” lacks an owner, an explicit interim instruction and a pre-distribution gate.

Tightness and organisation −3: “The app captures…” and “Keep the note specific enough…” repeat the immediately preceding capture instruction and section 03's handoff-context requirement without adding a concrete step.
Actionability −6: “Answer the programmed questions” assumes the questions are available; the qualifying-questions placeholder gives no instruction for proceeding if they are missing.

overall_findings: Sections 00 and 01 pass. Sections 02, 03 and 04 fail because at least one dimension is below 95.
Pending external decisions are not themselves defects. Deductions concern missing ownership, interim instructions, distribution gates or handoffs in their written treatment.
The brief's repeated stand line, conversation path and confidentiality rule serve its overview purpose. Detailed capture requirements generally have their appropriate home in section 04.

No supplied text names an internal customer or project, asserts an unapproved count or outcome, contradicts the confidentiality rule, or breaks the lead-save instruction. The SUBMIT instruction and submission-failure path are explicit.
Section 05 was not supplied and is outside scoring scope. Preservation of its live roster and event timetable cannot be verified from this excerpt.
